spans.s:
r. 1st cl. (दंशति)
To bite, to sting.

m. (-शः)
1 A gadfly.
2 A tooth.
3 Biting, stinging.
4 Armour, mail.
5 Cutting, dividing, tearing.
6 Fault, defect.
7 A joint, a limb.
8 The sting of a snake.
9 Pungency.
f. (-शी)
A small gadfly.
E.
दंश to bite or sting, affix अच्, diminutive affix ङीष्.

mfn. (-कः-का-कं)
What bites or stings.
m. (-कः)
A gadfly.
E.
कन् added to the preceding.

n. (-नं)
1 Biting, stinging.
2 Armour, mail.
E.
दंश to bite, &c. ल्युट् aff.

n. (-नं)
Armour, mail: see दंशन.

m. (-रुः)
A buffalo.
E.
दंश a gadfly, and भीरु afraid of; also with कन् added, दंशभीरुक m. (-कः.)

m. (-लः)
A plant, (Hyperanthera morunga.)
E.
दंश biting, and मूल a root; the root of this plant is substituted in Bengal for horseradish.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Armed, mailed.
2 Bitten, stung.
E.
दंश armour, and इतच् affix, or दंश to bite, affix क्त.

mfn. (-रः-रा-रं)
Mischievous, noxious.
E.
दंश to bite or sting, Uṇādi affix एरक्.

f. (-ष्ट्रा)
A large tooth, a tusk.
E.
दंश to bite, affix ष्ट्रन्, and टाप् fem. aff.

f. (-का)
The beard.
E.
दंष्ट्रा a tooth, इकन् aff.

mfn. (-ष्ट्री-ष्ट्रिणी-ष्ट्रि)
1 Biting or wounding with the teeth, (any animal, &c.)
2 Tusked, having tusks or sharp teeth.
3 Carnivorous.
m. (-ष्ट्री)
1 A hog.
2 A snake.
E.
दंष्ट्रा a tooth, and इनि aff.

f. (-नुः)
A daughter of DAKṢA, wife of KAŚYAPA, and mother of the demons of Daityas, the Titans of Hindu mythology.

m. (-नुः)
1 A donor, a giver.
2 A victor, a conqueror.
3

Prosperity.
4

Air, wind.
E.
दा to give, Uṇādi affix नु.

m. (-जः)
An Asura.
E.
दनु the mother of the giant race, and ज born.

m. (-द्विट्)
A god, a deity.
E.
दनुज a demon, and द्धिष् the hater.

m. (-रिः)
A god, a deity.
E.
दनुज, and अरि enemy.

m. (-नुः)
An Asura or infernal deity.
E.
दनु as above, and सूनु offspring; also similar compounds, as दनुज, &c.

m. (-न्तः)
1 A tooth.
2 The peak of a mountain.
3 The side or ridge of a mountain.
4 An arbour.
5 Ivory, elephant's tooth.
f. (-न्ती)
A medicinal plant, commonly known by the same name, Danti, (Croton polyandrum.)
E.
दम to subdue, तन् Uṇādi aff.

mfn. (-न्तः-न्ता-न्तं)
1 Tamed, subdued, daunted.
2 Bearing patiently privation, austerity, &c.
3 Dental.
m. (-न्तः)
1 A donor, a giver.
2 A well situated about the peak of a mountain.
E.
दम to tame, to pacify, affix क्त, or दन्त a peak, &c. affix अण्.

m. (-कः)
1 A crooked peak or projection in a rock or mountain.
2 A bracket, a pin or shelf projecting from a wall.
3 A tooth.
E.
कन् implying resemblance, added to दन्त.

m. (-णः)
The common lime, (Citrus acida.)
E.
दन्त a tooth, and कर्षण attracting, drawing.

n. (-ष्ठं)
A piece of stick, or of the small branch of a tree used as a tooth brush.
E.
दन्त, and काष्ठ wood.

m. (-दः)
A lip.
E.
दन्त a tooth, and च्छद a cover.

mfn.(-तः-ता-तं)
Toothed, having teeth.
E.
दन्त, and जात produced.

n. (-नं)
1 A tooth brush, or a fibrous stick used for cleaning the teeth.
2 Cleaning the teeth.
m. (-नः)
1 A tree yielding an astringent resin, (Mimosa catechu.)
2 A plant, (Mimusops elengi): see वकुल.
E.
दन्त a tooth, and धाव to clean, affix ल्युट्.

n. (-त्रं)
An earring.
E.
दन्त a tooth, and पत्र a leaf or plate set with studs, resembling teeth.

n. (-कं)
A kind of jasmine, (J. pubescens.)
E.
दन्त a tooth, and पत्र a leaf: the petals or leaves of the flower resembling teeth in colour and shape; this comparison is frequent among the poets.

n. (-नं)
A dentifrice, or any thing taken to clean the teeth.
E.
दन्त, and पवन purifying.

m. (-कः)
Gum boil.

m. (-ष्पः)
A plant, the flower of which is compared to a tooth, (Strychnos potatorum.)
E.
दन्त a tooth, and पुष्प a flower.

m. (-लः)
A plant: see the preceding.
E.
दन्त, and फल a fruit.

m. (-गः)
An elephant's front or forehead.
2 Part of a tooth.
E.
दन्त the tusk, and भाग a part.

mn. (-लः-लं)
The tartar of the teeth.
E.
दन्त a tooth, and मल dirt.

n. (-सं)
The gums.
E.
दन्त, and सांभ flesh.

f. (-का)
A plant: see दन्ती.
E.
दन्त, and मूल a root, कन् fem. form.

n. (-स्त्रं)
A lip.
E.
दन्त a tooth, and वस्त्र a garment.

m. (-साः)
A lip.
E.
दन्त a tooth, and वासस् vesture.

n. (-नं)
Fracture or decay of a tusk or tooth.
E.
दन्त, and व्यसन misfortune.

m. (-ष्टः)
The gums.
E.
दन्त, and वेष्ट what incloses.

m. (-टः)
A lime: see the next.

m. (-ठः)
1 Elephant or wood-apple: see कपित्थ.
2 Common lime, (Citrus acida.)
2 A plant bearing an acid fruit, (Averhoa carambola.)
4 An orange.
5 Sourness, acidity.
f. (-ठा)
Woodsorrel, (Oxalis monadelpha.)
E.
दन्त a tooth, and शठ noxious, bad.

f. (-रा)
Tartar of the teeth.
E.
दन्त tooth, and शर्करा sand.

n. (-णं)
A dentifrice, composed chiefly of the powdered fruit of the chebulic myrobalan, and green sulphate of iron.
E.
दन्त a tooth, and शाण a whetstone; sharpening or polishing the teeth.

f. (-रा)
The gum.
E.
दन्ता, and शिरा a long vein or tubular vessel.

f. (-द्धिः)
Cleaning the teeth.
E.
द्रन्त, and शुद्धि cleaning.

mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं)
Entangled in or between the teeth.
E.
दन्त, and श्लिष्ट united.

mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं)
Touched by the teeth; entangled in or between the teeth.
E.
दन्त, and सक्त in contact.

m. (-र्षः)
Tenderness of the teeth; intolerance of any rough, austere, or acid substances.
E.
दन्त, and हर्ष delight.

m. (-कः)
The lime, (Citrus acida.)
E.
दन्त a tooth, and हर्षक delighting, from हृष to please, with वुन् affix; also with युच् affix दन्तहर्षण, m. (-णः)

m. (-तः)
A bite.
E.
दन्त, and आघात a wound.

m. (-लः)
An elephant.
E.
दन्त a tooth, वलच् affix, and the final of दन्त made long.

m. (-धः)
A hog.
E.
दन्त a tooth or tusk, and आयुध a weapon.

m. (-दः)
A disease of the teeth or gums; gum boil, ulceration of the gums.
E.
दन्त a tooth, and अर्व्वुद a swelling.

f. (-का)
A horse's bridle.
E.
दन्त a tooth, अलि a line, affix कन्, and fem. form.

f. (-का)
A plant, commonly Danti, (Croton polyandrum.)
E.
कन् added to दन्ती; also read दन्तिजा, f. (-जा.)

mfn. (-न्ती-न्तिनी-न्ति)
Toothed, tusked.
m. (-न्ती)
1 An elephant.
2 A mountain.
E.
दन्त a tooth, and इनि possessive aff.

m. (-दः)
The temporal juice of the elephant.
E.
दन्ति and मद the effusion.

n. (-जं)
A strongly purgative nut, the fruit of the croton.
E.
दन्ती, and वीज seed.

mfn. (-रः-रा-रं)
1 Having a large or projecting tooth.
2 Waving, undulatory.
3 Rising (a hair), bristling.
E.
दन्त a tooth, &c. affix उरच्.

m. (-दः)
Dentition.
E.
दन्त, and उद्भेद out-break.

m. (-कः)
One who eats grain without its having been threshed, an anchorite.
E.
दन्त a tooth, उलखल a mortar, and ठक् affix; who winnows with his teeth.

mfn. (-न्त्यः-न्त्या-न्त्यं)
Dental, of or belonging to the teeth.
E.
दन्त, and यत् aff.

m. (-शः)
A tooth.
E.
frequentative form of दश to bite.

mfn. (-कः-का-कं)
Mischievous, malignant, venomous.
m. (-कः)
1 A snake or serpent.
2 A Rākṣasa, a demon or goblin.
E.
दश to bite, affix ऊक, the radical reiterated, and नुक् inserted.

n. (-मं)
Going slowly or tortuously.
E.
द्रम to go, root redup. घञ् aff.

n. (-णं)
Going slowly or tortuously.
mfn. (-णः-णा-णं)
Who or what goes so.
E.
द्रम to go, root redup. युच् aff.

(उ) दान r. 1st cl. irr. (दीदांसति-ते)
1 To cut.
2 To straighten or make straight.
3 To be straight.

n. (-नं)
1 Gift, giving, donation.
2 The fluid that flows from the temples of an elephant in rut.
3 Nourishing, cherishing.
4

Purification.
5

Cutting, dividing.
6 A present, a special gift.
7 Beating, striking.
8 Wild honey.
E.
दा to give, or दो to cut, affix ल्युट्.

f. (-ल्या)
The flow of an elephant's temporal ichor.
E.
दान, and कुल्या a river.

m. (-र्म्मः)
1 Almsgiving, charity.
2 The rules for making donations.
E.
दान, and धर्म्म virtue.

m. (-तिः)
1 A liberal or munificent man.
2 A name of AKRŪRA, the kinsman of KṚṢṆA.
E.
दान giving, and पति eminent.

n. (-व्यं)
Security for payment of a debt, &c.
E.
दान, and प्रतिभाव्य surety.

mfn. (-न्नः-न्ना-न्नं)
Divided or made hostile by bribes.
E.
दान, and भिन्न broken.

mfn. (-ग्यः-ग्या-ग्यं)
Fit for or meriting a donation.
E.
दान, and योग्य fit for.

m. (-वः)
A demon, a Titan or giant.
E.
दनु the mother of these beings, and अण् affix of descent.

m. (-ज्रः)
A Vaiśya or man of the third tribe.
E.
दान, and वज्र diamond.

m. (-र्षी)
1 An elephant in rut.
2 A liberal man.
E.
दान, and वर्षिन् showering.

m. (-रिः)
A deity.
E.
दानव a Titan, and अरि a foe.

m. (-रः)
A liberal man.
E.
दान, and वीर a hero.

m. (-सः)
Gift under error, as giving to the wrong person, &c.
E.
दान, and व्यत्यास perversion.

mfn. (-लः-ला-लं)
Liberal, munificent.
E.
दान giving, शील addicted to.

mfn. (-ण्डः-ण्डा-ण्डं)
Liberal, bountiful, munificent.
E.
दान a gift, and शौण्ड intoxicated, attached to violently.

mfn. (-नी-निनी-नि)
Giving.
E.
दान, and इनि aff.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
Worthy of having any thing given, or worthy or fit to be given.
n. (-नं)
Gift, donation.
E.
दा to give, अनीयर् affix of the future participle.

f. (-न्तिः)
1 The patient endurance of religious austerities or privations.
2 Subjection, humiliation.
E.
दम to tame, &c. affix क्तिन्.
